Writing
Build a complete, production-ready, mobile-first web application called:
SIGNBRIDGE — Indian Sign Language + Voice Translator
GOAL: Create a two-way communication application between a person using Indian Sign Language (ISL) and a person using spoken language.
The application must have these five core capabilities:
SIGN LANGUAGE → TEXT → VOICE
VOICE → TEXT
TEXT → SIGN LANGUAGE
CAMERA-BASED SIGN RECOGNITION
TWO-WAY REAL-TIME TRANSLATION
IMPORTANT: Do not create a static mockup. Build a functional application with working UI, camera permission handling, microphone permission handling, speech recognition, text-to-speech, sign recognition architecture, sign library, and persistent local history.
TECHNOLOGY: Use the platform's supported modern full-stack web technology. Use React/TypeScript if supported. Use browser APIs where available. Do not require Flutter. Keep the application responsive on Android mobile screens.
==================================================
HOME SCREEN ==================================================
Create a clean home screen with:
SIGNBRIDGE Indian Sign Language + Voice Translator
Large buttons:
[ SIGN → VOICE ] [ VOICE → SIGN ] [ TEXT → SIGN ] [ TWO-WAY MODE ]
Additional buttons:
[ Sign Library ] [ History ] [ Settings ]
Show microphone and camera permission status.
================================================== 2. SIGN → VOICE
Create a camera-based sign recognition screen.
UI:
Camera preview Recognition status Detected sign Translated text Confidence Speak button Clear button
Flow:
Camera → hand/sign detection → recognized sign → text → text-to-speech
Use the browser/device camera through getUserMedia where supported.
Request camera permission properly.
If the recognition model is unavailable, show:
"Sign recognition model is not installed yet."
Do NOT fake recognition.
Create a modular SignRecognizer interface so a real ML model can be connected later.
Example architecture:
SignRecognizer ├── initialize() ├── startCamera() ├── recognizeFrame() ├── stop() └── dispose()
Keep the recognition engine separate from the UI.
================================================== 3. SIGN RECOGNITION MODEL ADAPTER
Create a replaceable model adapter.
Create:
SignRecognitionEngine
with support for:
MediaPipe-compatible hand landmarks
TensorFlow.js-compatible models
Custom trained ISL model
The application must be designed so that a trained model can later be inserted without rewriting the UI.
Expected recognition result:
{ sign: "HELLO", confidence: 0.92, timestamp: ... }
Only accept a sign when confidence passes a configurable threshold.
Do not invent a recognition result when no model is available.
================================================== 4. VOICE → TEXT
Use Web Speech API where supported.
Create:
SpeechRecognitionManager
Functions:
startListening() stopListening() isSupported()
Display:
Listening... Recognized speech Language
Support:
English Hindi
Add language selector.
English: en-IN
Hindi: hi-IN
If Speech Recognition is unsupported, show a clear compatibility message.
================================================== 5. TEXT → VOICE
Use SpeechSynthesis API.
Create:
TextToSpeechManager
Functions:
speak(text, language) stop() pause() resume()
Provide:
[ Speak ] [ Stop ]
Use Indian English and Hindi voices where available.
Do not crash if a particular voice is unavailable.
================================================== 6. TEXT → SIGN LANGUAGE
Create a sign-language animation system.
Input:
Hello
Output:
HELLO sign animation
Create a Sign Library data structure:
Sign { id word language category animationUrl videoUrl imageUrl description }
Initially include a small starter vocabulary such as:
HELLO THANK YOU YES NO PLEASE SORRY HELP GOOD BAD WATER FOOD HOME NAME WHAT WHERE COME GO STOP WAIT
IMPORTANT: Do not claim that an invented animation is an authentic ISL sign.
If an authentic sign asset is unavailable, display:
"Sign asset not available."
Create the system so authentic ISL videos/animations can be added later.
================================================== 7. TWO-WAY MODE
Create a split-screen communication interface.
Person A:
Camera → Sign → Text → Voice
Person B:
Microphone → Voice → Text → Sign
Allow continuous conversation.
Display messages as chat bubbles.
Example:
Person A: [HELLO]
Person B: [Hello!]
Add:
[Start Conversation] [Pause] [Clear]
================================================== 8. SIGN LIBRARY
Create searchable sign library.
Categories:
Greetings Daily Communication Food Travel Emergency Family Numbers Education Work
Each sign card should contain:
Word Meaning Sign image/video/animation if available Play button
Search bar:
Search signs...
================================================== 9. HISTORY
Store translation history locally.
Each record:
id inputType inputText outputText language timestamp
Provide:
Delete Clear all history
Use localStorage or IndexedDB.
Do not send private conversation data to a server unless explicitly enabled by the user.
================================================== 10. PRIVACY
Create a Privacy section.
Clearly explain:
Camera is used for sign recognition. Microphone is used for speech recognition. Local history stays on the device unless cloud storage is explicitly enabled.
Never secretly record audio/video.
Do not upload camera frames unless the user has explicitly enabled a server/model that requires it.
================================================== 11. SETTINGS
Settings:
Language: English Hindi
Speech speed: 0.75x 1x 1.25x 1.5x
Recognition confidence threshold: Adjustable
Auto speak: ON/OFF
Auto translation: ON/OFF
Dark mode: ON/OFF
Clear history
Reset application
================================================== 12. ERROR HANDLING
Handle:
Camera denied Microphone denied Camera unavailable Microphone unavailable Speech recognition unsupported Speech synthesis unsupported No sign model installed No sign asset available Network unavailable Browser incompatibility
Never show fake successful recognition.
Use clear messages such as:
"Camera permission is required for sign recognition."
"Your browser does not support speech recognition."
"No trained sign-recognition model is connected."
================================================== 13. ACCESSIBILITY
Make the application accessible.
Include:
Large buttons High contrast Keyboard navigation ARIA labels Readable typography Clear status messages
The app must remain usable on mobile.
================================================== 14. UI DESIGN
Design style:
Modern Clean Professional Accessible Minimal
Main colors:
White Dark navy Blue accent
Use rounded cards and large touch targets.
Home screen should immediately show the two main actions:
SIGN → VOICE
VOICE → SIGN
================================================== 15. PROJECT STRUCTURE
Organize the project cleanly:
src/ components/ pages/ services/ recognition/ speech/ signs/ storage/ types/ utils/
Important files:
SignRecognizer SpeechRecognitionManager TextToSpeechManager SignAnimationManager TranslationService HistoryService CameraManager
================================================== 16. SECURITY
Never place private API keys directly in frontend source code.
Use environment variables for server-side secrets.
Validate user input.
Do not expose private credentials.
================================================== 17. DEMO MODE
Create an optional clearly labelled:
DEMO MODE
Demo mode must NOT pretend to be real AI recognition.
It can allow the user to select a sign manually from the Sign Library to demonstrate:
Sign → Text → Voice
Label everything clearly as:
DEMO — MANUAL SIGN SELECTION
================================================== 18. MODEL INTEGRATION
Create a documented integration point for a real trained ISL model.
The application should accept a model that returns:
label confidence
Example:
{ "label": "HELLO", "confidence": 0.94 }
Map recognized labels to the sign dictionary.
Use a debounce/stability mechanism so one gesture held for multiple camera frames does not repeatedly create dozens of translations.
================================================== 19. PERFORMANCE
Optimize camera processing.
Do not process every frame unnecessarily.
Use a configurable recognition interval.
Release camera tracks when leaving the camera screen.
Prevent memory leaks.
Stop speech recognition when leaving the page.
================================================== 20. FINAL REQUIREMENT
Generate the COMPLETE APPLICATION.
Do not return only a design. Do not return pseudocode. Do not return placeholder buttons that do nothing.
Every possible feature should be functional.
Where external ML model files or authentic ISL sign assets are genuinely required, create the complete integration interface and clearly identify exactly where those assets must be added.
Include:
Complete source code
Complete project structure
Configuration files
Responsive UI
Camera functionality
Microphone functionality
Speech recognition
Text-to-speech
Sign library
Translation history
Two-way mode
Model integration layer
Error handling
Accessibility
Privacy controls
README/setup instructions
Before finalizing, run the application's available build/test process and fix compilation/runtime errors that are detectable in the generated environment.
APPLICATION NAME: SIGNBRIDGE
TAGLINE: "Connecting Signs, Voice and People."
